name: 3D Box + Ice: Box 0 moves 4 north · 4t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 4 ticks after Start.
Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 0: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 2). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Ice.

Ticks 1–4 (each tick): Player moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
